description: [Wicked Identity] START HERE if you have no wallet or cannot sign messages. Returns a sandbox wallet + sandbox_token (no signing, no body). Then call identity_get_challenge and identity_submit_response with wallet + sandbox_token. Sandbox results are for trying the service: signed with a separate key (identity_jwks sandbox=true) and never reported as verified. Use a real wallet for an accountable identity. Limit: 10 per IP per hour.
name: identity_sandbox_register
